title: 01. Foundations: Temperature & Top-P (Sampling Parameters)
summary: Before understanding Temperature and Top-P, understand this:

sections.title: 8.1 How LLMs Generate Text (The Foundation)
sections.body:
Before understanding Temperature and Top-P, understand this:

> When an LLM generates the next word, it doesn't just pick ONE word. It calculates **probabilities for ALL possible words** and then picks one based on those probabilities.

**Example — After "The sky is":**
```
"blue"       → 45% probability
"clear"      → 20% probability
"beautiful"  → 15% probability
"dark"       → 10% probability
"gray"       → 8%  probability
"purple"     → 2%  probability
...thousands more words with tiny probabilities
```

**Temperature and Top-P control HOW you pick from this list.**

sections.title: 8.2 Temperature
sections.body:
### Simple Definition
> **Temperature controls how CREATIVE vs PREDICTABLE the LLM's responses are.**

Think of it like a dial:
```
🧊 COLD (Low Temperature)    ───────────────────    🔥 HOT (High Temperature)
   More Predictable                                    More Creative/Random
   0.0                                                 2.0
```

### What Temperature Does Mathematically
Temperature **reshapes** the probability distribution:

**Temperature = 0 (Greedy/Deterministic)**
```
"blue"    → 100% (always picks the highest probability word)
"clear"   → 0%
"beautiful" → 0%
Result: ALWAYS the same answer. No creativity.
```

**Temperature = 0.7 (Balanced)**
```
"blue"      → 45%
"clear"     → 20%
"beautiful" → 15%
"dark"      → 10%
Result: Mostly predictable but some variety
```

**Temperature = 2.0 (Very High)**
```
"blue"      → 25% (flattened, more equal)
"purple"    → 20%
"triangular"→ 15% ← unlikely words now get chances!
"dancing"   → 15%
Result: Creative but potentially nonsensical
```

### When to Use What Temperature

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              TEMPERATURE GUIDE                           │
├──────────────────┬───────────┬────────────────────────── ┤
│   USE CASE       │   TEMP    │    REASON                 │
├──────────────────┼───────────┼───────────────────────────┤
│ Factual Q&A      │  0.0-0.2  │ Need accurate, consistent │
│ SQL generation   │           │ answers every time        │
│ Code generation  │           │                           │
├──────────────────┼───────────┼───────────────────────────┤
│ Summarization    │  0.3-0.5  │ Accurate but not robotic  │
│ Classification   │           │                           │
│ Translation      │           │                           │
├──────────────────┼───────────┼───────────────────────────┤
│ Chatbots         │  0.7-0.9  │ Natural, varied responses │
│ Email writing    │           │                           │
│ Explanations     │           │                           │
├──────────────────┼───────────┼───────────────────────────┤
│ Brainstorming    │  1.0-1.5  │ Novel, creative ideas     │
│ Story writing    │           │                           │
│ Poetry           │           │                           │
└──────────────────┴───────────┴───────────────────────────┘
```

sections.title: 8.3 Top-P (Nucleus Sampling)
sections.body:
### Simple Definition
> **Top-P controls which words are even ELIGIBLE to be picked by only considering the top words whose probabilities add up to P.**

### Analogy: The VIP List
> Imagine a nightclub with Top-P = 0.9. The bouncer lets in guests until the total "popularity" reaches 90%. The most popular people get in first.

**Top-P = 0.9 Example:**
```
"blue"       → 45%  ← Add to pool. Running total: 45%
"clear"      → 20%  ← Add to pool. Running total: 65%
"beautiful"  → 15%  ← Add to pool. Running total: 80%
"dark"       → 10%  ← Add to pool. Running total: 90% ← STOP! Hit 0.9
"gray"       → 8%   ← ❌ NOT eligible (we've hit our P limit)
"purple"     → 2%   ← ❌ NOT eligible
```

Now pick RANDOMLY from {"blue", "clear", "beautiful", "dark"}.

**Top-P = 0.1 (Very Restrictive):**
```
"blue"  → 45% ← Add. Total: 45% ← STOP! Already hit 0.1... 
                                    Wait, 45% > 10%, so just "blue"!
Only "blue" is eligible → Always picks "blue"
```

**Top-P = 1.0 (No Restriction):**
```
ALL words are eligible → Most creative/random
```

### Temperature vs Top-P — What's the Difference?

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│         TEMPERATURE vs TOP-P                             │
├───────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┤
│     TEMPERATURE       │           TOP-P                  │
├───────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────┤
│ Reshapes ALL the      │ Cuts off the TAIL of low-        │
│ probabilities         │ probability words                │
│ (makes them flatter   │                                  │
│  or steeper)          │                                  │
├───────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────┤
│ Controls overall      │ Controls which words are even    │
│ randomness level      │ considered                       │
├───────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────┤
│ Think: "How wild      │ Think: "Should I only consider   │
│ should guesses be?"   │ top candidates?"                 │
└───────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Recommended Settings for Your Team

```python
# PRODUCTION CODE/SQL GENERATION (deterministic, accurate)
temperature = 0.0
top_p = 1.0

# CHATBOT (natural, varied but sensible)
temperature = 0.7
top_p = 0.9

# CREATIVE WRITING (imaginative)
temperature = 1.2
top_p = 0.95

# BRAINSTORMING (most creative)
temperature = 1.5
top_p = 1.0
```

### Other Sampling Parameters

| Parameter | What It Does | Typical Value |
|-----------|-------------|---------------|
| **Top-K** | Only consider top K words | 40-100 |
| **Max Tokens** | Maximum response length | Task-dependent |
| **Stop Sequences** | Stop generating at this text | `["\n\n", "END"]` |
| **Frequency Penalty** | Penalizes repeating words | 0.0 - 2.0 |
| **Presence Penalty** | Encourages new topics | 0.0 - 2.0 |
